## TASK-016 - Compare one matched baseline with the existing enabled pilot

Run one fresh comparable baseline multi-solver Task under the frozen protocol without billboard exchange, then compare it with TASK-012 enabled evidence using the same effective settings and comparable budgets.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-003, REQ-040, REQ-045, REQ-060, REQ-061, REQ-063 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | Verification/shared-agent-billboards/comparison/results.json, Verification/shared-agent-billboards/comparison/REPORT.md |
| Dependencies | TASK-010, TASK-012, TASK-015 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Reusing candidate-containing context or changing settings would invalidate the comparison; inability to control these leaves REQ-061 incomplete.

### Acceptance criteria

- Baseline and enabled cases have comparable task difficulty/criteria, identical effective model and reasoning settings, declared budgets and fresh uncontaminated participant contexts.
- Report earlier contradiction detection, late dependency discovery, relevant-finding reuse, final criteria satisfaction, recovery context and communication time/token cost with evidence and limits.
- Use the already captured enabled native pilot once; unknown telemetry remains unavailable rather than estimated as measured, and no statistical or universal improvement claim is made from one pair.
- The comparison reports useful outcomes even if there is no improvement; message count alone is not a success measure.

### Planned verification

- Run only the one baseline case, compare its bounded receipts with TASK-012, and review measurement provenance and comparability. No additional benchmark campaign.

### Risks

- Ready requirements or a passing helper suite cannot establish unrun native pilots, root activation or external publication.

### Acceptance criteria

- All original 62 TRD requirements and REQ-063 map to current artifacts and sufficient reused evidence; every changed artifact maps back to a requirement.
- The final inspection follows current evidence and affirmatively records each protected path/group preservation result; source, Template, fixtures, dependencies and exact manifests agree.
- Release evidence distinguishes inspection, deterministic fixtures, actual native behavior, comparison and exercised disposable setup; missing mandatory evidence leaves completion blocked.
- Operations document direct posting, visibility, checkpoint/acknowledgement, pending delivery, recovery, limits and adoption prerequisites without claiming live root/product activation.
- No whole-suite rerun occurs after passing unchanged checks; only affected failures or materially changed evidence receive targeted revalidation.

### Planned verification

- Reopen affected source/Template/fixture artifacts, review the evidence ledger in both directions and compare exact protected-state hashes once. Run only the selected managed-plan/Task owner validation required for final state.
